sex.evidence: In total, 204 8-week-old C57BL/6J male mice were purchased from Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology.

dosing.evidence: Psilocin (Cayman Chemical Company) were dissolved in 0.9% saline. In the acute METH administration model... the doses of psilocin were 5 mg/kg, 1 mg/kg, or 0.25 mg/kg... In the METH-induced CPP model, the dose of... psilocin... were 1 mg/kg

handling.evidence: Methods describe housing and adaptation but do not mention any handling protocol.

enrichment_housing.evidence: Methods describe standard housing but do not mention cage enrichment.

assays.assay_description: Mouse activity monitored in an open field for 1 h following acute drug administration; used to test effects of psilocin alone, psilocin+METH, and TFP-2HCl/SCH772984+METH on locomotion.

application_type.evidence: administered prior to i.p injection of METH

setup_restrain.evidence: mouse activity was monitored in an open-field for 1 h

food_restriction.evidence: mouse activity was monitored in an open-field for 1 h (no food in apparatus)

water_restriction.evidence: mouse activity was monitored in an open-field for 1 h (no water in apparatus)

time_to_assay.evidence: psilocin/TFP-2HCl/SCH772984 administered prior to i.p. injection of METH; standard pre-treatment ~30 min before testing as used in CPP

sample_size.evidence: 24 mice were divided into four groups... 25 mice were divided into four groups... 36 mice were divided into six groups... n = 6-7

outcomes.summary: Acute METH (2 mg/kg) significantly increased locomotor activity. Psilocin at 1 mg/kg inhibited METH-induced hyperactivity, whereas 0.25 mg/kg had no effect; psilocin alone at 5 mg/kg increased activity but 1 and 0.25 mg/kg did not. The D2R inhibitor TFP-2HCl (2 mg/kg) and ERK inhibitor SCH772984 (10 mg/kg) also blocked METH-induced hyperactivity.
outcomes.evidence: 5 mg/kg psilocin group exhibited increased activity compared to the control group (p < 0.05)... 1 mg/kg psilocin significantly inhibited METH-induced hyperactivity in mice (p<0.01)... 2 mg/kg TFP-2HCl and 10 mg/kg SCH772984 significantly inhibited METH-induced hyperactivity

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total activity over 1 h reported as a single value per animal

B5_social.evidence: Animals tested individually in open field

B6_cognitive.evidence: Open field locomotor measurement, no learning required

D2_session_duration.evidence: monitored in an open-field for 1 h

assays.assay_description: Two-compartment CPP apparatus (15×15×37 cm; black mesh vs white grid floor) with pre-test (day 1, 15 min), acquisition (days 2–9, conditioning with saline/METH ± drug; post-test day 10, 15 min), extinction (days 11–22, with periodic 15-min tests), and reinstatement test (15 min). CPP scores measured.

application_type.evidence: injected (i.p) with METH... injected (i.p) with 1 mg/kg psilocin

setup_habituation.evidence: On day1, mice were pre-tested for 15 min — pre-test serves as baseline measurement rather than dedicated habituation; no separate apparatus habituation described

setup_restrain.evidence: mice was allowed to shuttle freely in the apparatus

food_restriction.evidence: Standard CPP apparatus, no food in chamber during 15-min test

water_restriction.evidence: Standard CPP apparatus, no water in chamber during 15-min test

time_to_assay.evidence: Drugs administered 30 min before METH during conditioning; CPP tested at post-test day 10, extinction tests across days 13-22, and reinstatement test

sample_size.evidence: n = 5-7 (acquisition); n = 5-10 (extinction); n given per group across figures

outcomes.summary: METH (1 mg/kg) produced significant CPP. Psilocin (1 mg/kg) given before METH during conditioning inhibited acquisition of CPP. Psilocin had no significant effect on extinction or METH-primed reinstatement. D2R inhibitor TFP-2HCl (2 mg/kg) and ERK inhibitor SCH772984 (10 mg/kg) also blocked CPP acquisition.
outcomes.statistics: Acquisition interaction F(3,20)=8.998, p<0.001; time F(1,20)=4.432, p=0.0481; treatment F(3,20)=13.34, p<0.001. Extinction F(9,75)=5.177, p<0.001. Reinstatement F(3,19)=18.39, p<0.001. TFP/SCH acquisition F(5,41)=3.135, p<0.05.
outcomes.evidence: injection of the 1 mg/kg psilocin before METH significantly inhibited the increase in CPP scores of the METH group (p < 0.001)... psilocin did not impact METH extinction and relapse

judge_notes: Two distinct behavioural paradigms identified: open-field locomotor monitoring (collapsing all dose arms and the TFP-2HCl/SCH772984 experiments) and the CPP paradigm (collapsing acquisition, extinction, and reinstatement into one assay per rubric).
Resolved B1 disagreement: paper reports a single locomotor measure ('mouse activity') for OFT and a single CPP preference score for CPP → score 0 (1 measure) for both, not 1 (2-3).

D3 for CPP set to 8-14 (score 2) rather than 2-7: pre-test day 1, post-test day 10, plus repeated extinction tests on days 13, 16, 19, 22 (the procedure was 'repeated three times over days 14-22') and a reinstatement test — totaling ≥7 distinct recording days.
D2 for CPP set to 15-60 min (score 1): tests were explicitly 15 minutes (the lower bound), per rubric '15 to 60 minutes inclusive → score 1'.
Setup habituation for CPP scored 'no' (rather than 'yes' as one candidate suggested) because the day-1 pre-test is itself a recorded baseline trial, not a no-data habituation exposure.
Housing day_night_flipped marked not_reported with high confidence — 12:12 cycle stated without direction.
TFP-2HCl and SCH772984 are not psychedelics but are administered alongside psilocin in the same OFT/CPP paradigms; their data are folded into the same two assays.
